mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, original_topic, topic, side_a_label, side_b_label, debate_axis, side_a_frame, side_b_frame, selected_round_id, round_title, basic_conditions, candidate_run_id, selected_candidate_id, mode, status, peak_reached, selected_side, selected_round_no, created_at, stopped_at FROM debate_sessions WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, user_id, original_topic, topic, side_a_label, side_b_label, debate_axis, side_a_frame, side_b_frame, selected_round_id, round_title, basic_conditions, candidate_run_id, selected_candidate_id, mode, status, peak_reached, selected_side, selected_round_no, created_at, stopped_at FROM debate_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE debate_sessions SET status = #{status}, stopped_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'STOPPED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE stopped_at END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO debate_messages (debate_session_id, speaker, round_no, content) VALUES (#{debateSessionId}, #{speaker}, #{roundNo}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, debate_session_id, speaker, round_no, content, created_at FROM debate_messages WHERE debate_session_id = #{debateSessionId} ORDER BY id ASC
